name: cicash
summary: A budget you lend to an AI agent, not money you give it.

zero_install.effect: self-test proving 11 invariants, exit 0 on pass

invariants: delegation is attenuation-only and cannot be reversed without the root key
a settlement debits every ancestor in the lineage
a token without its key cannot spend
the amount and payee come from a merchant-signed quote, never from the agent
an idempotency key never charges twice, including across a restart
a parent cap does not tear under concurrency

denial_actions.REPLAN: this request cannot pass; another may
denial_actions.ESCALATE: no request can pass; tell the principal
